notes: Added missing schema/contract, API contract hardening, and normalization layer stories to complete FEAT-2 coverage.

stories.title: Define Specialty Identification Input/Output Schema
stories.description: Create and formalize Pydantic models for specialty identification requests and responses, including normalized query text, candidate specialties, NUCC codes, confidence scores, and classification groups.

stories.title: Normalize and Preprocess User Input for Specialty Mapping
stories.description: Implement preprocessing pipeline to clean, tokenize, and normalize user input (e.g., synonyms, abbreviations, casing) before passing to regex and vector pipelines to improve matching accuracy.

stories.title: Harden Tool Router Contract for Specialty Identification
stories.description: Ensure tool_router enforces strict validation and allowlisting for specialty identification calls, including schema validation, error handling, and safe fallback when inputs are malformed or incomplete.

stories.title: Implement Confidence Scoring and Ranking for NUCC Matches
stories.description: Enhance aggregation logic to assign confidence scores to each identified NUCC specialty and rank results, enabling downstream services to prioritize the most relevant specialties.
